newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sending 5,000 troops to Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sending 5,000 troops to Kuwait.

text.p: THe United States will send 5,000 Army troops to Kuwait as part of a military buildup in the Gulf in reaction to recent tensions with Iraq, the Defense Department said on Friday.

The troops are from the 1st Calvary Division at Fort Hood, Texas, will be flown to Kuwait this weekend to join 1,200 other U.S. soldiers who have been in Kuwait since August training with the Kuwaiti armed forces in a military exercise, the Pentagon said.

"They are going as part of our prudent effort to protect our interests in the Gulf," said Pentagon spokesman Sam Grizzle. He said the troops will use equipment such as M-1A1 tanks and Bradley Fighting Vehicles already pre-positioned by the American military in Kuwait.

Although Iraq promised on Friday to stop shooting at U.S. and Allied warplanes over no-fly zones in that country, the United States reacted cautiously and said it would continue a military buildup in the region, which already includes a second aircraft carrier, U.S. radar-avoiding Stealth fighters and heavy bombers.
